verdict.rationale: Kit lists "Audience tagging & segmentation" as a plan feature. Broadcasts can target subscribers by segment or tag IDs, and segments are exposed as an account object via the Kit MCP, so segmentation exists. Custom fields provide profile attributes. However, nothing in the evidence shows how segments are defined (e.g., rules combining custom fields, tags, and behavioral events) or that they update dynamically as data changes. Missing for 10: documented segment rule-building on custom fields and tags, behavioral-event criteria, live/dynamic segment membership, independent or hands-on corroboration.
